changeSet.author: bng-team
changeSet.comment: Record the authenticated actor separately from the project owner so every project audit entry identifies who performed the change.

changeSet.author: bng-team
changeSet.comment: Audit the authenticated actor held in projects.last_modified_by, rather than copying projects.user_id (the project owner).
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION bng.write_projects_audit_log() RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$ BEGIN INSERT INTO bng.audit_log ( project_id, project, user_id, bng_project_version, operation, audited_at ) VALUES ( NEW.id, NEW.project, NEW.last_modified_by, NEW.bng_project_version, TG_OP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ); RETURN NEW; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

changeSet.author: bng-team
changeSet.comment: Store the previous project document alongside the resulting snapshot, making the changed values explicit without reconstructing history.
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION bng.write_projects_audit_log() RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$ BEGIN INSERT INTO bng.audit_log ( project_id, project, previous_project, user_id, bng_project_version, operation, audited_at ) VALUES ( NEW.id, NEW.project, CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN OLD.project ELSE NULL END, NEW.last_modified_by, NEW.bng_project_version, TG_OP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ); RETURN NEW; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

changeSet.author: bng-team
changeSet.comment: Prevent project deletion until a sanctioned deletion workflow can provide an authenticated actor and retain the deleted project state.
changeSet.rollback: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS projects_reject_unaudited_delete ON bng.projects; DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS bng.reject_unaudited_project_delete();
